about: Monster numbers. Every species starts from base and lists only what is different. hp in hit points, times in seconds, distances in metres. body.hop follows the model's Jumping clip: it leaves the ground at liftOff and lands at land (seconds of clip time). scale sizes the whole slime; tint recolours its body (null keeps the model's own blue); pace plays its clips faster (above 1) or slower; stride is how far each hop goes compared with the normal one; radius is how much room it takes. takes: how much of each element's damage it takes (1 = normal, above 1 = weak to it). A slime that is hit gets angry for anger.time seconds: it chases the player (never further than anger.leash from home) and attacks; the blow lands at attack.strikeAt of attack.cycle if the player is within attack.reach. Slimes that are not angry only threaten and never hurt. exp: what beating one gives. drops: what it may leave behind: item id, chance 0..1, and how many (min..max).
